key_insight: METTA proposes memory-enhanced test-time adaptation to help reinforcement learning agents adapt quickly to unfamiliar tasks. It targets the challenge of using long interaction histories without relying solely on compressed recurrent states or costly transformer retrieval.
problem_solved: Meta-reinforcement learning agents must extract useful task evidence from limited interactions while retaining information over time. Recurrent models compress that evidence into hidden states, while transformer-based approaches incur quadratic memory and computation costs.
method: Introduce Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation (METTA) for adapting agents to unseen tasks.
